description: This is a PHP source file defining the CalendarEventQueryFactory class. The factory class provides a method for creating CalendarEventQuery objects configured with specific date ranges for synchronizing calendar events within given past and future days.

classes.name: CalendarEventQueryFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating CalendarEventQuery instances with specific date ranges for calendar synchronization.

methods.name: forSyncWindows
methods.description: Prepares a CalendarEventQuery object to retrieve calendar events within a specified window defined by pastDays and futureDays parameters, with an optional limit.
